services.name: Private Boat Charter
services.desc: Enjoy a smooth, and fun-filled boat cruise around the intercostal waterways of Fort Lauderdale, the Sand bar, and of course our crystal clear ocean spots! Spend the day soaking up the Florida sun on the brand new Aqua Flight charter Boat and enjoying activity add-ons such as Flyboarding, underwater Seabob, snorkeling, or electric surfboard and more! The tour itself has many different options and can be catered to your needs. From Sandbar hopping, to bar & Restaurant stops, all the way to a full watersport's filled day, we can do it all. What to Bring Sunscreen Photo I.D. Bathing Suit Drinks

blurb: Guests can enjoy jet ski rentals, flyboarding, kayaking, and other luxury water toys on board yachts or at Fort Lauderdale beach. The company offers both adrenaline-filled adventures and relaxing float lounging experiences. Services include rentals, repairs, concierge, storage, and custom yacht solutions.
